obligations.summary: Deployers of high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III (except point 2) must provide affected persons with clear and meaningful explanations of the AI system's role in the decision-making procedure and the main elements of any decision that produces legal or similarly significant adverse effects on their health, safety, or fundamental rights.
exceptions: AI systems listed under point 2 of Annex III are excluded from this right to explanation.
The obligation does not apply where Union or national law (in compliance with Union law) provides exceptions or restrictions to this right.
This Article applies only to the extent that the right to explanation is not already provided for under Union law.
